description: This file defines the class PayGradeCurrencySearchFilterParams, which extends FilterParams and is used for filtering search parameters related to pay grade currencies, including setting and retrieving the pay grade ID.

classes.name: PayGradeCurrencySearchFilterParams
classes.description: A data transfer object (DTO) class for specifying search filter parameters related to pay grade currencies, including setting and getting the pay grade ID, with a default sort field set to 'ct.name'.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the search filter parameters and sets the default sort field to 'ct.name'.

methods.name: setPayGradeId
methods.description: Sets the pay grade ID for filtering.

methods.name: getPayGradeId
methods.description: Retrieves the current pay grade ID used for filtering.
